_doc: The state registry shared by island themes (M5) and character packs (M6). Versioned major.minor:
a new state is a new entry with a sensible fallback and a minor bump, so an older theme or pack
never breaks; a state it doesn't implement walks its fallback chain to one it does.
Core states (no fallback) must be implemented by every theme and pack.
inputs: the live values a state gets. kind: loop (holds until the next state) or oneshot (plays once,
then the app moves on). aliases: names the assistant uses for the same state (Bridge.state modes).
heyclaude/states.py loads, validates and resolves it.
budgets: frame rates a character or theme may run at (idle: a resting loop on its own; rest: off / asleep;
antic: an idle antic playing), the longest antic, and how fast an antic must give way to a real state.
1.1 (M6): budgets, and the sleep progression drowsy / asleep / waking.

inputs.level: mic level 0..1 (~12 Hz while the mic is open)
inputs.amplitude: loudness of the voice it is speaking 0..1 (~30 Hz)
inputs.progress: 0..1 of something with an end (loading, a pause, the followup window)
inputs.cursor: pointer position relative to the island
inputs.text: the line shown with the state

states.description: Wake word armed, nothing happening (all day).
Listening switched off: the mic is closed.
The mic is open and it is hearing the user.
Working out the answer.
Speaking the answer.
The wake word (or the hotkey) just fired: the catch.
The hold key is down: pauses don't end the turn.
Hold key down with Ctrl+Shift: still holding, the mic muted.
Listening again without the wake word for a few seconds after an answer.
The talk-or-type field is open (hotkey).
Dictation into another app (M4d).
Models are loading or reloading.
Listening paused for a while; it resumes by itself.
A task or a watched session is running.
Sending something on the user's behalf (Telegram etc.), after approval.
Waiting for the user to approve an action (M7).
A task finished well.
Something went well.
Something failed.
It didn't understand, or needs the user.
Idle and nobody around for ~15 min: heavy-lidded, slower.
Nobody around for ~30 min: dozing (the wake word still works).
The user came back after a doze: a stretch, then idle.
The speaker check rejected a wake (not your voice?).
